text:
maria: quick check — I pushed a small tf change to add a surge-smoothing config to the inference provisioner, want to make sure HPA/VPA fallbacks are still sane. PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/infra/pulls/487

ajay: looking. main change is `maxSurgeWindow: 30s` + a new annotation to prefer vpa when cpu target goes above 70%?

maria: yup. also wired the vault secret path for the metrics-adapter to the new service account. config diff:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_annotation" "inference-provisioner" {
  metadata {
    annotations = {
      "karpenter.sh/scale-surge-window" = "30s"
      "redwood.io/prefer-vpa" = "true"
    }
  }
}
```

jen: does the metrics-adapter SA have permission to read the new path? I remember we renamed the Vault secret for prometheus last quarter.

maria: SA is `infra-metrics-sa`. I added a policy bind in the tf change: `vault_generic_secret_versioned_read` for `secret/data/infra/metrics/*`

tomas: can you paste the TF plan lines for the role binding? want to double-check the principal.

maria: sure — plan snip:
```text
+ vault_policy_binding.metric_reader[0] 
    bound_service_account = "infra-metrics-sa"
    path = "secret/data/infra/metrics/*"
```

ajay: thanks. two questions: 1) HPA target cpu stays at 60%? 2) VPA mode is set to "fallback" or "auto"?

maria: HPA target remains 60. VPA is set to "auto" but we added the annotation `redwood.io/prefer-vpa=true` so when both present the router will bias to VPA-provisioned instances for sustained load.

jen: how will this affect canary scaling? we recently saw canary pods getting killed because Karpenter provisioner scaled down too fast.

maria: good call. I added `karpenter.sh/ttl-after-provisioned: 5m` on canary namespaces, and `kubernetes.io/max-unavailable: 1` on the deployment spec.

ajay: any change to podDisruptionBudget? we rely on PDBs for stateful parts of the inference pool.

maria: no PDB changes in this PR. but I did lower the MUP in the provisioner to 2 for the inference pool to reduce thrash during surge.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch: infra/hpa-vpa-surge-maria — status: running (build #792) :gear:

tomas: can you run a local canary test before we merge? suggest `kubectl apply -f canary-deploy.yaml` then `weight: 10%` for 10 minutes. watch autoscale metrics in console.

maria: yes will do. quick run outline:
1) apply tf in staging (plan only)
2) apply k8s annotation patch to canary ns
3) generate synthetic load with `hey` against the canary service
4) watch HPA, VPA and Karpenter events

jen: for step 1 — tag me on the plan comment. I want to validate the Vault binding.

ajay: also add a small smoke test to the PR that checks `metrics-adapter` logs for successful Vault read (grep for "secret read OK"). keeps us from merging with wrong policy.

maria: noted. I'll add a GH action job `smoke/metrics-vault` that runs after plan.

infra-bot: build #792 succeeded — integration tests passed :white_check_mark:

tomas: nice — if the smoke test passes i'm fine to approve.

maria: pushed the smoke job and applied a short canary in staging. initial run looks good: HPA scaled from 3 -> 5, VPA suggested +2 replicas but didn't force replace, Karpenter provisioned 2 nodes and respected `ttl-after-provisioned`.

jen: can you paste the event that shows Karpenter respected the ttl? want to keep in the thread for audit.

maria: event excerpt:
```text
Normal  Provisioned       2m   karpenter-controller  Provisioned new node xg-ix-03, ttlAfterProvisioned=5m
Normal  ScaleDownCooldown  30s  karpenter-controller  scale-down suppressed due to ttlAfterProvisioned
```

ajay: looks good. I left a small comment on the PR to tighten path in the Vault binding to `secret/data/infra/metrics/adapter` (avoid wildcard).

maria: will update. anything else?

tomas: one small ops note — add a dashboard tile for prefix cache hit-rate, if we see high VPA recommendations but low cache misses that could indicate noisy long-tail requests.

maria: adding that to the PR description as a follow-up task.

jen: LGTM after Ajay's secret path tighten.

maria: thanks all — will push fix and merge after CI. :thumbsup:
